symptom: A Data grid 2 column with no attribute, no content widgets and no ShowContentAs (`column (Caption: '')`) still reports **CE0463** under `mx check --no-update-widgets` after its header is fixed; `fix widgets` changes only its `tooltip`, null -> empty Forms$ClientTemplate
cause: `detectObjectListItemKind` classifies a column as attribute-kind only when an attribute is BOUND, so an unbound column fell to `itemKindDefault`, which has no rule in `emptyClientTemplateRules` — its tooltip stayed null. update-widgets keys the convention on showContentAs, whose widget default is `attribute`
insight: Classify by the EFFECTIVE showContentAs (authored, else the widget's DefaultValue), not by whether an attribute is bound. Found only by diffing every column property against `fix widgets` output after the header fix (ChipCoV8 #11) — the header was the first of two differences on the same column, and checking only the reported property would have stopped there. Measured on 11.15.0: CE0463 gone; what remains is Mendix's own legitimate "An attribute is required when 'Show' is set to 'Attribute'", which the CE0463 had been masking
